name: Password Change Success
summary: Records successful authenticated replacement of the password credential while preserving the durable identity and authenticated session.

sourceState.expression: durable-identity == resolved and session-capability is authenticated

guards.expression: current password is valid and replacement password satisfies active identity policy

sourceReferences.note: Emits this transition when the password manager result is successful.
ASP.NET Identity adapter performs credential replacement and records ChangePasswordSuccess.
Integration proof exercises the real flow and LagoVista manager chain before the Microsoft Identity boundary.
